import json, pathlib, sys
sys.path.insert(0, 'scripts')
import execution_spec as S, run_id as R
def read(p):
    return pathlib.Path(p).read_text(encoding='utf-8')
lines = read('docs/missions/MODEL_ROUTING.md').splitlines()
note = 'Note (F000): F000 safety net accepted: golden argv, evidence audit, Python 3.12/3.14 CI, test discovery, shared run-id validation'
assert lines.count(note) == 1, 'F000 routing note missing or duplicated'
i = [k for k, l in enumerate(lines) if l.startswith('Note (F013): ')][0]
assert lines[i + 1] == '' and lines[i + 2] == note and lines[i + 3] == '' and lines[i + 4].startswith('These family labels'), lines[i:i + 5]
for p in sorted(S.PROVIDERS):
    for c in (1,) + tuple(S.PROVIDER_CONTRACTS_V3):
        g = json.loads(read('tests/fixtures/golden-argv/%s-v%d.json' % (p, c)))
        assert g['provider'] == p and g['contract'] == c and g['cases'], (p, c)
        assert all(x['argv'] and x['spec'] for x in g['cases']), (p, c)
assert S.CURRENT_PROVIDER_CONTRACT == max(S.PROVIDER_CONTRACTS_V3) == 9
ci = read('.github/workflows/ci.yml').splitlines()
for tok in ('  lint-and-test:', '          fetch-depth: 0', '          python-version: ${{ matrix.python }}', '          - os: ubuntu-latest', '          - os: macos-latest', '            python: "3.12"', '            python: "3.14"', '      - name: Suite runs the matrix Python', '        run: python3 tests/test-evidence-2a.py', '        run: bash tests/run-tests.sh'):
    assert tok in ci, ('ci.yml', tok)
assert '  for file in tests/test-*; do' in read('tests/run-tests.sh').splitlines(), 'runner does not glob tests'
good = '0f1e2d3c-4b5a-4968-8778-6a5b4c3d2e1f'
assert R.validate_run_id(good) == good
for bad in (good.upper(), '{' + good + '}', 'urn:uuid:' + good, good + chr(10), ' ' + good, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000', good[:14] + '0' + good[15:], good[:19] + 'c' + good[20:], None, 7):
    try:
        R.validate_run_id(bad)
    except ValueError as e:
        assert str(e) == 'run_id must be a canonical UUID', str(e)
    else:
        raise SystemExit('run_id accepted %r' % (bad,))
for mod in ('execution_spec', 'verification_record', 'ledger', 'reconstruct_run', 'seat_smoke'):
    assert 'validate_run_id' in read('scripts/%s.py' % mod), mod
agents = read('AGENTS.md')
for rule in ('- Tests run in an isolated scratch tree; they never modify or depend on the live tree.', '- An adapter argv change requires a new provider contract version; the golden argv test enforces it.', 'Never write to the repository while a worker or brain run is in progress; never start a duplicate long-running check.'):
    assert rule in agents.splitlines(), ('AGENTS.md', rule)
assert '{{' not in agents, 'consumer placeholder in AGENTS.md'
skills = ''.join(read(p) for p in sorted(pathlib.Path('.agents/skills').glob('*/SKILL.md')))
for rule in ('## Proof rules from 2A', 'For a bug fix, reproduce the bug on the unfixed tree before dispatch, because a task whose oracle never failed on the base proves nothing.', 'Pair each negative test with one targeted mutation of the guard expression that makes that test fail', 'An oracle fails on any compile or import error, because a check that cannot load the code under test has proved nothing.', 'Seat limits come from probes and are recorded in the registry; never rely on login checks inside a sandbox.'):
    assert rule in skills, ('skills', rule)
pg = read('docs/missions/20261014-2a-foundation/PROGRESS.md').splitlines()
assert pg[0].startswith('> **FROZEN** after the T-016 refresh'), pg[0]
s = pg.index('## Current status (2026-10-19)')
e = next((k for k in range(s + 1, len(pg)) if pg[k].startswith('## ')), len(pg))
block = ' '.join(pg[s:e])
done = [f['id'] for f in json.loads(read('docs/missions/20261014-2a-foundation/features.json'))['features'] if f.get('passes') is True]
assert len(done) == 16 and all(fid in block for fid in done), done
print('ok')

set -u
t=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$t"' EXIT
mkdir -p "$t/scripts" "$t/tests"
cp scripts/harness-path.sh "$t/scripts/"
cp tests/run-tests.sh "$t/tests/"
: > "$t/CHANGELOG.md"
echo 'print(1)' > "$t/tests/test-a-pass.py"
echo 'raise SystemExit(3)' > "$t/tests/test-b-fail.py"
out=$(cd "$t" && bash tests/run-tests.sh --files-only 2>&1)
rc=$?
test "$rc" -ne 0 || { echo 'runner exited 0 with a failing test'; exit 1; }
a=$(echo "$out" | grep -nxF '  ok   : tests/test-a-pass.py' | cut -d: -f1)
b=$(echo "$out" | grep -nxF '  FAIL : tests/test-b-fail.py' | cut -d: -f1)
{ test -n "$a" && test -n "$b" && test "$a" -lt "$b"; } || { echo "$out"; exit 1; }
rm "$t/tests/test-b-fail.py"
(cd "$t" && bash tests/run-tests.sh --files-only >/dev/null 2>&1) || { echo 'runner failed with only passing tests'; exit 1; }
echo ok
